# domq

> A tiny, zero-dependency, never-panicking HTML parser with CSS selectors — for Rust, your shell, JavaScript (a ~58 KB gzipped WebAssembly module, ~80 KB with reader mode and extraction) and Python.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/iamsaquib8/domq): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://iamsaquib8.github.io/domq/): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
